_why: The records table's word on the scans this archive may show (tools/build-records.py reads it).
A plate is `show: true` only if /family-papers/ already publishes it under that page's own rule (every person named on it is dead).
FamilySearch plates are never held here (the archive cites them by ark and reads them in the viewer): link only.
TNA downloads are never republished (cite the reference). Matricula-style or third-party images: link only.
The `hold` list is what the archive holds and will not show, so no row is ever made for it.
